description: Pig and Pig compatibility in the Chinese zodiac: the same animal, their Water elements, yin-yang, and what helps the pairing.
answer: In Chinese astrology, two Pigs share the same branch, Water element and Yin polarity, so the match is read as a mirror. Each recognises the other's generosity, sincerity and warmth; the pairing tends to work best when the shared blind spot, the Pig's avoidance, is named early.

sections.heading: How two Pigs relate
paragraphs: The Pig tends to bring generosity, warmth and an easygoing spirit to a relationship. It often makes home a place of comfort and enjoyment. On first meeting, the Pig often comes across as warm, relaxed and generous. Traditional readings associate the Pig with generosity, sincerity and warmth, and in a same-animal pair that quality is present twice. What the Pig tends to value most in a partner is sincerity, warmth and a shared love of life's pleasures. Hearty meals, belly laughs and forgiving kindness usually win a Pig completely.

Two Pigs may have been born in the same year or twelve, twenty-four or more years apart, so their year elements can differ even though the animal is shared. The Pig usually needs sincerity, appreciation and a partner who is honest and kind. Both partners usually need this at once, which can be a source of deep understanding or of competition for the same thing. Friends often notice that two Pigs share habits as well as values, from how they handle plans to how they greet strangers.

sections.heading: What the tradition says about a same-animal pair
paragraphs: When both partners are Pigs, the Chinese zodiac pairs an animal with itself. Classical tables do not list same-animal pairs among the harmonies or clashes; traditional readings instead describe them as mirrors, in which the Pig's generosity, sincerity and warmth is shared and so are its blind spots. Two Pigs often create a warm, generous and comfortable partnership with shared enjoyment of life. Kindness comes easily. The risk is that both avoid hard decisions or practical problems. Pairs of Pigs tend to do best when they agree on a few responsibilities and check in on them regularly.

Every Pig shares the Wood trine with the Rabbit and Goat, has the Tiger as its Liu He secret friend, and sits opposite the Snake in the six clashes. Because the Pig pairs with itself here, the Wood trine still frames the relationship: both partners share the same natural allies and the same opposite. In the traditional double-hour clock, the Pig also names the hours from 9 pm to 11 pm.

sections.heading: Five elements and yin-yang
paragraphs: Two Pigs share Water as their fixed element. In five-element thinking a shared element is read as mutual recognition, so each Pig tends to understand the other's instincts, with the caution that the same strengths and excesses are doubled. As Yin animals, two Pigs share the same polarity, inward and receptive in traditional terms. In five-element terms the Pig's Water is associated with depth and adaptability, a quality two Pigs hold in common.

In everyday terms, the shared Water of the Pig and the Pig suggests intuition, adaptability and depth, along with a tendency for moods to mirror and amplify each other. Each birth year also carries its own element from the heavenly stems, so a Metal Pig and a Water Pig read slightly differently, and two Pigs born exactly twelve years apart will have year elements one step apart in the cycle. For example, the Pig year of 2007 was a Fire year and the Pig year of 2019 an Earth year, so two Pigs born in those years differ in flavour.

sections.heading: Friction and what helps two Pigs
paragraphs: Under stress, the Pig can avoid conflict, procrastinate or ignore problems in the hope they will resolve on their own. When both partners respond this way at once, the pattern tends to amplify rather than balance out. After an argument, the Pig usually forgives easily, and a Pig who also addresses the underlying issue ensures it does not quietly recur.

Between two Pigs, friction usually stays mild but can surface as avoidance, with chores, bills and hard conversations postponed indefinitely. Resentment may build quietly. A cheerful weekly check-in on practical matters tends to keep two easygoing partners from letting problems pile up.

What helps with a Pig is gentle honesty, shared enjoyment and taking practical tasks on together rather than leaving them to drift. For two Pigs, agreeing in advance who will step back first when the Pig's avoidance appears can keep a shared trait from becoming a shared problem, and taking turns in that role keeps it fair.

sections.heading: Two Pigs day to day
paragraphs: At home, the Pig tends to make life comfortable and welcoming, appreciating a Pig who enjoys good food and company. A full fridge, comfortable seating and an open invitation to friends are hallmarks of a Pig household. Two Pigs often share a generous, comfortable home with a full table and an open door. Indulgence comes naturally. Agreeing on a few responsibilities, and checking on them cheerfully, keeps two easygoing companions from letting important tasks slide.

Traditionally the Pig usually enjoys relaxing, convivial outings such as feasts, spas, picnics and gatherings with friends, which two Pigs can enjoy side by side. As a colleague, the Pig is cooperative and hardworking; beside the Pig, it keeps morale high and offers sincere support. Hospitality, team morale and generous collaboration are where the Pig usually makes its mark. On a shared team, two Pigs tend to reinforce each other's generosity, which is a real asset once roles are clearly divided.

faq.question: Are the Pig and the Pig compatible in the Chinese zodiac?
faq.answer: Classical tables do not rate same-animal pairs as harmonies or clashes. Two Pigs tend to understand each other quickly and share the same blind spot, the Pig's avoidance, so awareness matters more than any rating.

faq.question: What are the elements of the Pig?
faq.answer: The Pig's fixed element is Water and its polarity is Yin. Each birth year adds a separate year element from the heavenly stems.

faq.question: Which animals are best for the Pig?
faq.answer: Traditionally the Rabbit and Goat share the Pig's San He trine and the Tiger is its Liu He secret friend.

faq.question: What might the Pig and the Pig enjoy doing together?
faq.answer: Traditionally the Pig usually enjoys relaxing, convivial outings such as feasts, spas, picnics and gatherings with friends. Two Pigs often enjoy these side by side, and taking turns to choose keeps plans fresh.

faq.question: Does the Chinese zodiac use the calendar year?
faq.answer: No. Animal years begin at Lunar New Year: the Pig year of 2019 began on February 5, and the one before it, in 2007, on February 18, so January birthdays need checking. The calculator does this automatically.
